{{Quote|Why, sure. It's a General Spacetronics ''MaKing''-class transport. The rear flanges mean it's the Janako model &mdash; made locally under license. Looks to me like there's some kind of modification around the gunports &mdash; may have been upgunned.|Roark Garnet|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
The '''Janako''' was a model of the [[MaKing-class transport|''MaKing''-class transport]] that was manufactured by [[General Spacetronics]] and made under local license.<ref name="TRG1" /> It shared its name with the [[Janako system/Legends|Janako system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" >{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The Janako featured distinguishing rear flanges and featured [[Weapon/Legends|gunports]].<ref name="TRG1" />

At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] was asked whether he could identify a specific [[Unidentified Janako|starship]]. Garnet confidently identified it as a Janako that appeared to him to have been modified.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Janako was first mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" />
